title: Creamy Broccoli Kugel
instructions: Thoroughly wash the broccoli and trim off the tough ends. Cook in a 3-quart saucepan with water to cover until tender but not too soft. Add the vegetable bouillon to the water and continue to cook. Drain and mash the broccoli.
Combine the margarine, flour, and nondairy creamer in a 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Simmer over a low flame until thickened. Remove from the flame and allow to cool 5 minutes.
Add the mayonnaise, onion soup mix, and eggs and mix well. Add the cooled mixture to the broccoli and mix until well combined.

Grease an 8-inch square pan. Pour 1/4 cup of the crumbs on the bottom of the pan and pour the broccoli mixture on top. Sprinkle the top with the remaining 1/4 cup corn flake crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes.
